python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly Judiciary outlays (in millions of dollars) from Jan 1984 to Mar 1987
# From 1985 bulletin page 22 (1984 data)
outlays_1984 = [84, 89, 63, 74, 62, 93, 65, 79, 69, 79, 67, 96]  # Jan-Dec 1984

# From 1986 bulletin page 26 (1985 data)

# From 1987 bulletin page 24 (1986 data)
outlays_1986 = [76, 109, 74, 129, 75, 71, 70, 106, 87, 73, 73, 113]  # Jan-Dec 1986

# From 1988 bulletin page 36 (1987 data - Jan-Mar only)
outlays_1987 = [79, 76, 110]  # Jan-Mar 1987

# Combine all data: Jan 1984 to Mar 1987
all_outlays = outlays_1984 + outlays_1985 + outlays_1986 + outlays_1987

print(f"Number of months: {len(all_outlays)}")
print(f"Outlays: {all_outlays}")

# Calculate geometric mean
# Geometric mean = (product of all values)^(1/n)
product = 1
for val in all_outlays:
    product *= val

geo_mean = product ** (1/len(all_outlays))
print(f"\nGeometric mean (in millions): {geo_mean:.6f}")
print(f"Geometric mean rounded to nearest thousandth: {round(geo_mean, 3)}")

# Let's also verify using log method
log_sum = sum(math.log(x) for x in all_outlays)
geo_mean_log = math.exp(log_sum / len(all_outlays))
print(f"Geometric mean using log method: {geo_mean_log:.6f}")
EOF
